summary: VivoPower PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting that it has shortlisted AI operator tenants for its 41.5MW Norway data center after a competitive RFP process. The company previously acquired the Mo i Rana facility and rejected acquisition offers at a premium. It now plans to lease the site to AI operators for 10+ years, targeting agreement by June 30, 2026. No specific price, premium, or material terms were disclosed. This is a routine operational update on a leasing process, not a definitive special situation event. Watch for definitive lease agreements or further disclosures.
